title: Add bounded investigation judgments and stopping outcomes
summary: Extend fixed-packet assessment with narrowly controlled evidence requests once the basic judgment families are qualified. An investigation must pursue a named uncertainty using host-approved candidate reads and retain why it stopped; it cannot become an autonomous retrieval loop that hides cost or manufactures sufficiency.
in_scope: Gap-specific candidate evaluation and bounded follow-up packets
Stopping receipts, repeated-request suppression and remaining conflicts
implementation: Represent the missing claim requirement, eligible source roles, candidate reads, expected information gain and remaining budget in the investigation request.
Use qualified relevance/gap judgments only to rank the permitted candidates; deterministic host controls select and execute the read.
Record each returned observation and prepare a new packet through the same provenance and availability rules.
Implement explicit stops for sufficient evidence, no eligible source, conflict, exhausted budget, stale purpose and a genuinely authorized decision.
Detect repeated equivalent read requests and require a changed gap or evidence revision before another cycle; preserve counterevidence requirements throughout.

acceptance.criterion: Budget exhaustion and unavailable sources never produce a resolved or evidence-sufficient result.
acceptance.verification: Run exhausted-round and denied-source fixtures and inspect distinct terminal reasons.

acceptance.criterion: A candidate outside the host-provided source set cannot be fetched regardless of model ranking.
acceptance.verification: Inject an out-of-set candidate ID and assert validation failure with no read call.

acceptance.criterion: Repeated requests for the same unchanged gap stop without losing its unresolved status.
acceptance.verification: Replay an unhelpful retrieval loop and inspect suppression count, budgets and preserved gap.

tests: New counterevidence remains in the next packet.
A task switch cancels a pending investigation.
A sufficient-evidence judgment still passes the domain assessment policy.
risks: Adaptive retrieval can preferentially confirm the first hypothesis.
A timeout must not be misreported as an answer to the gap.

reuse.application: Use separately defined stopping questions as conceptual references while the host enforces limits.
